main_text.p: pecuniaque eius agnatûm gentiliumque esto. Quidam iudicatus est parentem occidisse, & statim quòd effugiendi potestas non fuit, ligneae soleae in pedes inductae sunt: os autem obuolutum est folliculo, & praeligatum. Deinde est in carcerem deductus, ut ibi es-set tantisper, dum culeus, in quem coniectus in profluentem deferretur, compararetur. Interea quidam eius familiares in carcerem tabulas afferunt, & testes adducunt. Heredes, quos ipse iubet, scribunt. Inter eos qui heredes in tabulis scripti sunt, & inter agnatos, de hereditate contro-

page.notes: The right margin carries a repeated printed "«" mark beside every line; these are typographic line markers, not text, so they are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "gentiliumque" (line end "gĕ", no printed hyphen, reading inferred from the next line "tiliumque"); "es-set" (the printed "ef-" / "fet" with long s, read as esset); the running head letters are spaced and blurred, so "IVRISCONSVLTVS" is marked [?]. The paragraph continues onto the next page ("contro-").
